facts.fact: 侍女替 Allie 换上深绿丝绸长裙与厚毛皮斗篷，祖母绿发夹重回发间（衣饰为公主所赠）
facts.anchor: Under a thick fur cloak, layers of soft, deep forest green silk composed my outfit

facts.fact: 半透明巨球凭空绽出，像有看不见的压力把现实向外撑开，光与景物被扭曲
facts.anchor: Great translucent spheres bloomed into existence, as though reality was being forced outward

facts.fact: Allie 冲出门撞上国王胸口，国王扶住她急问是否受伤，随后拉她穿过满地碎石的庭院
facts.anchor: his prompt urgent, even as his eyes tracked whatever was happening around us. “Are you injured?”

facts.fact: 额头流血的 Gregory 冲出拦住两人，指控国王把“地狱”带进他的王国，并称不该信暴君
facts.anchor: You assured me that you wouldn’t bring your manner of hell to my kingdom.

facts.fact: Allie 认出异象与污染“泪之河”的异常同源，推断有人动用那台穿越机器，Gregory 也身处险境
facts.anchor: This phenomenon was similar to the anomaly that contaminated the River of Tears.

facts.fact: 崖石塌向 Gregory 时，Allie 不假思索扑上去撞开他，两人倒地；国王的魔法随即在头顶把落石击成粉末
facts.anchor: Without thinking, I hurled myself forward, slamming into Gregory’s chest to drive him aside.

facts.fact: Sophie 用手按住兄长 Gregory 的太阳穴，以发光的手治愈他额头的伤——她是他的妹妹、Lucerne 公主，也是治疗者
facts.anchor: “You’re bleeding.” Sophie lifted a delicate hand and laid it on her brother’s temple.

facts.fact: 第一个巨球五倍于一辆马车（coach）大小，横穿右邻建筑塔楼的尖顶，砖石被拉成不可能的角度
facts.anchor: A sphere five times the size of a coach intersected the spire of the tower in the adjacent structure to my right.
